mentions.name: Early-90s fantasy console (WASM)
mentions.description: A WASM-based fantasy console with the feel of early 90s computing, 100% vibe coded; it can run Doom and was built as a constrained target that the author's free-to-use vibe coding platform can one-shot apps for.
mentions.problem: The entire world of all apps is too hard to one-shot with the current set of free LLM models, so the console provides a smaller target for the vibe coding platform.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm vibe coding a fantasy console with the feel of early 90s computing.

100% vibe coded WASM based. It runs Doom so far.
